udakapappaṭaka.p: [Udaka+pappaṭaka] (pu) CL=7 (A) The water layer. (It is called the Fertile top-soil in Vi,saṅgaha, sya, 1. 236. When water sinks into the earth, sand or soil power covers the upper part of that water and it is float. Although water is dry up, that layer moves in blowing (wind). This layer is called Udakapappaṭaka). (3) Slime or Moss.
